greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube noxolo lwasezulwini nabasekhaya kuni sonke namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu ofika ebusuku xa indlu ithule du, kwaye konke okuseleyo kungqine ukuba akukho nto ingaphaya kokuthula kwamacandelo efanitshala nezinto ezishiywe ngumntu owakha wahlala apho. Ucinga ngaloo mboniso kaBen esesemncinci, ehleli ekhaya ebusuku, ejonge izixhobo zakhe zekhompyutha kunye neendlela zokubhabha zeenqwelo-moya, ngamanye amaxesha ehleka kancinci xa ecinga ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe eyayizaliswe ngamaphupha amahle. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukuqonda ubunzulu benjululwazi, kodwa intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo eyobuchwephesha obubandayo; yayiyeyomntwana owazi uthando, owazi ukuhleka kunye nokuba nosizi ngabanye.

Namhlanje kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos usibeka phambi kwento enzulu kakhulu. Uthi: 'Kuba ngowenkululeko uKristu wasikhulula; ngoko yimani ngenkalipho, ningaphindi nizibambe kwidyokhwe yobukhoboka.' Apha, um Apostle akathethi nje ngezinto ezingaphandle; uthetha ngaloo ndlela intliziyo yethu eboshwa ngayo kukuzama ukulawula ubomi, kukuzama ukufumana indlela eyiyo yokugcina zonke iingozi kude, ukuzama ukuba yiyo yonke into kubantu abasithandayo. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu, Alan noThao. Nizanile ngothando olungenamiqathango. Kodwa ihlabathi linamendu alo, kwaye zintlungu eziqhekeza imiphefumlo yethu ngendlela esingayiqondiyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaLuka, uYesu uya kwisidlo endlwini yom Pharisi, kwaye lo m Pharisees uyamangaliswa kukuba uYesu angahlambi ngendlela eyayimiswe ngayo ngaphambi kokuba adle. UYesu uyaphendula ngamazwi abukhali abethelela inyaniso engaphakathi: 'Nina BaFarisi niyacoca ngaphandle kwendebe nesitya, kodwa ngaphakathi nizele kukuphanga nobungendawo.' Lo mfanekiso wendebe ehluble ngaphandle kodwa engcolile ngaphakathi usikhumbuza into enkulu kakhulu. Asingabo abantu abafuna ukubonakala bengeyonto ethile emehlweni ehlabathi; uThixo ujonge intliziyo. Ujonge apho uthando lukaBen lwalukhanya khona ngokwenene, ingengoba kwakukho izinto ezinkulu zokuzibonisa, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayenentliziyo enovelwano eyayingafihli lutho.

Masimi apha ixesha elincinci… Masicinge ngendlela uBen awayenobubele ngayo, engabali kwaye engacingi ngobugovu. Khumbula loo mzuzu omangalisayo apo lo mntwana omncinci, eneminyaka eli-15 kuphela ubudala, wathetha nabazali bakhe efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselive zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo kuba yayingadingeki, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha njengomsinga ongaqondakaliyo. Kukho imibuzo eza ebusuku, kukho imizuzu apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokuze nako kwenza ngokwahlukileyo. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi kum Pharisi kwiVangeli, 'Nika ubulungisa, futhi khangelani ukubakonza abo bafuna uncedo, kwaye zonke izinto ziya kuba cocekile kuni.' Ubulungisa bukaThixo asisisiqwenga somthetho esixinzelelayo; lububele obukukhululayo. UBen akalahlekanga; usebukhoneni obukhulu boMthombo wothando. Uthi xa ucinga ngaye, ucinge ngaloo ntwana enemfesane, umfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu kangaka.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam Yesu Kristu, Ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente Eyingcwele yaseAltar. Ndayikhupha intliziyo yam kuwe ngaphezu kweento zonke, kwaye ndiyakunqwenela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingakwazi ukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemizimbeni, nceda uze kum ngomoya wam ebudeni bale nkonzo. Ndiyamkela kwaye ndidibene nawe ngokuphelele; ungaleki ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onjeng Uyise angasigcina sonke ekhanyeni lakhe, asenze siphile ngothando olungenabuxoki, kwaye asikhokelele kude kube lixesha lokuba siphinde sidibane nabathandekayo bethu ezulwini. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin kunye nabo bonke abemkayo baphumle kukhanya olungunaphakade lukaKristu, sibongoza.
Ukuze abo bonke abasiziweyo nabazilileyo bafumane intuthuzelo nethemba elivela kuThixo, sibongoza.

readings.label: Ukufundwa kokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana: Ngowenkululeko uKristu wasikhulula; ngoko yimani ngenkalipho, ningaphindi nizibambe kwidyokhwe yobukhoboka. Ndithi mna Pawulos kuni, ukuba niyamkela ukusoka, uKristu akayi kuba ncedo kuni kwaphela. Ndiphinda ndiqinisekisa wonke umntu osokayo ukuba unyanzelekile ukuba agcine umthetho wonke. Wahlukile kuKristu nina nizama ukuba ngamalungisa ngomthetho; niwile kububele bukaThixo. Kuba ngoMoya, ngokholo, silinde ithemba lobulungisa. Kuba kuKristu Yesu akukho nto incedayo ukusoka okanye ukungasoki, ngaphandle kokholo olusebenza ngothando.

readings.label: INdumiso Yempendulo
readings.text: Makuze kum, Nkosi, ububele bakho, Usindiso lwakho ngokwesithembiso sakho. Sukususa ilizwi lenyaniso emlonyeni wam, Kuba ithemba lam likwimiyalelo yakho. Ndiyakugcina umthetho wakho ngamaxesha onke, Ngonaphakade naphakade. Ndiyakuhamba ngokukhululeka, Kuba ndifuna imimiselo yakho. Ndiyakuthakazelela imiyalelo yakho, Endiyithandayo. Ndiyakuphakamisa izandla zam emiyalelweni yakho endiyithandayo, Ndicamance imithetho yakho.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Akugqiba uYesu ukuthetha, umFarisi wamema ukuba adle naye endlwini yakhe; wena wena wangena wahlala etafuleni. Wathi umFarisi akubona wamangaliswa ukuba engahlambanga ngaphambi kwesidlo. Wathi iNkosi kuye: 'O nina BaFarisi! Niyacoca ngaphandle kwendebe nesitya, kodwa ngaphakathi nizele kukuphanga nobungendawo. Zidenge! Lowo owenze okwangaphandle akangenzi na nokwangaphakathi? Kodwa ezo zinto zisezongaphakathi, ziqabeleni ngezinto zenceba, nize nibone ukuba zonke izinto ziya kuba cocekile kuni.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
